GameplayEvent Rules12 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event is a collaboration with Demon Slayer, titled "Isekai Demon Hunter Arc," and abbreviated as "Demon Hunter".

◆ After the event ends, there will be no way to obtain the event-exclusive characters.

◆ Fellow Shinobu Kocho has the [Resonance Effect] feature, which allows her to "resonate" with chosen Fellows, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Shinobu Kocho to LR will additionally unlock the [Resonance Skill] feature.

◆ Shinobu has the [Origin Boost] skill, which can significantly increase her power.

◆ After you upgrade Shinobu to LR quality, the Stella feature will also be unlocked. Increase the Trust Level of LR Shinobu as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ Demons lurk in the shadows, and the Demon-Slayer swordsmen follow their trails — hidden away from the eyes of ordinary people, these swordsmen wage an endless battle against the demons.

Demon Slaying Mission

◆ The Demon Slaying Mission includes main quests and challenges. Challenges are unlocked only after clearing the story stages. Entering a stage or challenge consumes Stamina; if you fail, the consumed Stamina will be refunded.

◆ For stages that have already been cleared, you can use the Sweep function to quickly consume stamina and obtain the stage rewards.

◆ Stamina restores over time (1 point every hour). Activating the Pass increases the stamina cap to 80. You can also restore stamina using specific items.

◆ Clear stage 2-5 to obtain the event-exclusive SSR Fellow: Inosuke Hashibira.

Power Increase

◆ Use the Power Increase feature to boost your stats. The items required for power increase can be obtained by clearing or sweeping stages.

◆ You can also gain additional stat bonuses by activating the event-exclusive characters. Activating a character from the gacha or upgrading their rarity will further boost your stats.

◆ Activating the event pass grants 30% ATK and HP bonuses for the Demon Slaying Mission.

◆ All power increase effects are non-transferable (cannot be inherited).

Demon Slaying Mission Stages

◆ Your team consists of 5 characters. Each tile color corresponds to one character; clearing tiles charges the skill of the matching color character.

◆ When you clear tiles, they attack the enemy directly above them and charge the skill of the character with the matching color. Consecutive clears (combos) deal higher damage.

◆ Skills can be used once fully charged. Each character has different skills, which can be viewed by tapping their portrait during battle.

◆ Demon Slaying Mission stages are turn-based. Your team always acts first. After your turn ends, all enemies take action in order from the front row to the back row, from left to right.

◆ During the enemy turn, if an enemy's attack countdown is greater than 1, it decreases by 1. If it is 1, that enemy will attack your team.

◆ Defeat all enemies in all waves to clear the stage.

◆ If all your characters' HP reaches 0, the stage will be failed.

Character Attributes

◆ Fellow ATK = Base Value * (1 + Power Increase Bonus + Total Power Bonus + Extra Bonus)*2

◆ Fellow HP = Base Value * (1 + Power Increase Bonus + Total Power Bonus + Extra Bonus)*6

Skip Battle

◆ If your ATK and HP in Demon Slaying Mission exceed the recommended requirements by 20% in Main Quests, or 10% in Challenge Stages, you can skip the battle directly.

Wave Restart

◆ Players can choose to retry during battles to restart from the beginning of the current wave. Retries are limited; once exhausted, you must re-enter the stage to refresh your retry attempts.

Event Pass

◆ While participating in Demon Slaying Mission, you will earn Pass EXP in proportion to the Stamina consumed.

◆ Earn rewards by reaching specific Pass EXP milestones. Purchasing the pass unlocks premium rewards.

◆ Upon activating the event pass, in addition to receiving 10 Gacha Tickets, you also unlock the following special effects: Stamina cap increased to 80 and +30% ATK and HP bonuses in the Demon Slaying Mission minigame.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claim period), improving Shinobu's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Upon the event's conclusion, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you ranked among the top 3 and increased Shinobu's Aptitude to 10000, you will win an exclusive permanent Dynamic Frame.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

Check-In

◆ Log in during the event period to claim check-in rewards.

To remake the village celebration cake, you set off on an adventure with friends from Isekai... but why does each of them have such weird little "quirks"?!

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

AquaFellow · AquaMeguminFamily · MeguminKazumaFellow · KazumaDarknessFellow · DarknessFigure [Cooking Master]Player Costume · Cooking Master
GameplayEvent Rules9 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event is a collaboration with KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!. Titled "God's Blessing on This Laid-Back Isekai!," abbreviated as "KONONON!".

◆ After the event ends, there will be no way to obtain the event-exclusive characters.

◆ Fellow Aqua has [Resonance Effect] feature, allowing players to resonate with a chosen fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Upon advancing Aqua to LR, the [Resonance Skill] feature becomes available.

◆ Aqua has skill [Origin Boost], which can significantly increase her power.

◆ Once Aqua's rarity reaches the LR quality, the Stella feature will unlock. Increase the Trust Level of LR Aqua as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ To remake the village celebration cake, you set off on an adventure with friends from Isekai... but why does each of them have such weird little "quirks"?!

Adventure

◆ The adventure journey includes story missions and challenges. Challenges are unlocked only after clearing the story missions. Entering a stage consumes stamina; if you fail, the consumed stamina will be refunded.

◆ For stages that have already been cleared, you can use the Sweep function to quickly consume stamina and obtain the stage rewards.

◆ Stamina restores over time (1 point every hour). Activating the Pass increases the stamina cap to 80. You can also restore stamina using specific items.

◆ Clear stage 2-5 to obtain the Limited SSR Fellow: Darkness.

Power Increase

◆ Use the Power Increase feature to boost your stats in adventure. The items required for power increase can be obtained by clearing or sweeping stages.

◆ You can also gain additional stat bonuses by activating limited characters. Activating a character from the gacha or increasing the rarity of event-limited characters will further boost your stats.

◆ Activating the event Pass grants a 30% ATK and HP bonus within the adventure.

◆ All power increase effects are non-transferable (cannot be inherited).

Adventure Stages

◆ Your team consists of 5 characters. Each tile color corresponds to one character; clearing tiles charges the skill of the matching color character.

◆ When you clear tiles, they attack the enemy directly above them and charge the skill of the character with the matching color. Consecutive clears (combos) deal higher damage.

◆ Skills can be used once fully charged. Each character has different skills, which can be viewed by tapping their portrait during battle. Note: Megumin's skill can only be used once per stage; use it wisely.

◆ Adventure stages are turn-based, and your team always act first. After your turn ends, all enemies take action in order from the front row to the back row, from left to right.

◆ During the enemy turn, if an enemy's attack countdown is greater than 1, it decreases by 1. If it is 1, that enemy will attack your team.

◆ Defeat all enemies in all waves to clear the stage.

◆ If all your characters' HP reaches 0, the stage will be failed.

Event Pass

◆ While participating in adventure, you will earn Pass EXP in proportion to the stamina consumed.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ Upon activating the event Pass, in addition to receiving 10 Gacha Tickets, you will also unlock special effects: the stamina cap increases to 80, and gain a 30% ATK and HP bonus within the adventure stages.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Aqua's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Upon the event's conclusion, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you ranked among the top 3, and Aqua has reached 10000 Aptitude, you will win an Limited Permanent Dynamic Avatar Frame.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

Check-In

◆ Log in during the event period to claim check-in rewards.
